key_claims.claim: Quantum computing improves predictive analytics, customer segmentation, sentiment analysis, portfolio optimization, and risk modeling in business intelligence.
key_claims.quote: This research combines a systematic literature review with a meta -analysis of 26 peer-reviewed articles spanning from 2014 to 2025 to show how quantum computing improves predictive analytics and customer segmentation and sentiment analysis, portfolio optimization, and risk modeling.
key_claims.location: Abstract, Page 1

key_claims.claim: Hybrid quantum-classical systems deliver exponential speed, accuracy, and scalability benefits over classical models.
key_claims.quote: The research uses PRISMA guidelines together with strategic foresight tools to detect how hybrid quantum-classical systems replace classical models by delivering exponential speed and accuracy, and scalability benefits.
key_claims.location: Abstract, Page 1

key_claims.claim: QSVM, QAOA, and quantum-enhanced neural networks are primary methodologies for real-time, adaptive decision systems in business.
key_claims.quote: The research demonstrates that QSVM, QAOA, and quantum-enhanced neural networks serve as primary methodologies to create real-time, emotionally intelligent, highly adaptive decision systems.
key_claims.location: Abstract, Page 1

key_claims.claim: Quantum algorithms provide quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo methods for financial simulations.
key_claims.quote: While Quantum Monte Carlo simulations have long been a standard in finance for tasks like derivative pricing, quantum algorit hms such as QAE provide a quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo methods. This reduction in computational complexity, from O( 1/ϵ^2)to O(1/ϵ), where ϵ is the estimation error, enables faster and more efficient risk modeling, particularly crucial in high-volatility markets.
key_claims.location: Section 3.2.2 Financial forecasting and risk optimization, Page 5

key_claims.claim: Quantum annealing and QAOA show significant speedup and scalability in large-scale portfolio optimization.
key_claims.quote: By applying QAE, QA, and QAOA, researche rs have demonstrated significant speedup and scalability in portfolio selection problems involving thousands of assets with comp lex return, volatility, and budget constraints [44].
key_claims.location: Section 3.2.2 Financial forecasting and risk optimization, Page 5–6

key_claims.claim: Hybrid quantum-classical sentiment models like LSTM-VQC significantly improve performance without extensive data preparation.
key_claims.quote: Hybrid models lik e LSTM-VQC, which integrate quantum technology with classical approaches, further enhance sentiment analysis capabilities, achieving  92.59% accuracy in processing concerns and speaker identities in dialogues [16, 17]. These models, by incorporating noise -resistance methods, improve performance without requiring extensive data preparation steps typical in classical data science methods.
key_claims.location: Section 3.2.1 Marketing intelligence and sentiment analysis, Page 4–5

key_claims.claim: Quantum computing has transitioned from a theoretical concept to an actionable business solution.
key_claims.quote: Quantum computing has transitioned from being a theoretical concept to an a ctionable business solution.
key_claims.location: Introduction, Page 2

key_claims.claim: Most reviewed studies are experimental or hybrid, indicating a trend toward simulation/benchmarking on real-world datasets.
key_claims.quote: Importantly, if we look at the designs of the studies mentioned in Table 1, we can see that most of  them are experimental (i.e., truly meant to translate to physical implementations) or hybrid (involving both classical and quantum approaches), indicating a trend towards simulation/benchmarking on real-world datasets rather than theoretical im-pact.
key_claims.location: Section 3.1 Mapping the landscape of quantum business research, Page 3

key_claims.claim: Quantum methods outperform classical techniques in large, complex optimization and classification tasks.
key_claims.quote: Quantum Methods, including Quantum Support Vector Machines (QSVM), Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), and Gaussian-Enhanced Quantum Deep  Neural Networks (GEQDNN) , are pushing the boundaries of classical methods , including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Deep Neural Networks (DNN), and Monte Carlo simulations, especially in fields with vast amounts of data and complex computations.
